question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.

WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name as league_name,
        c.name as country_name,
        t.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as home_points,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as away_points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name as league_name,
        c.name as country_name,
        t.team_api_id,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as home_points,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as away_points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
),
team_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_name,
        country_name,
        team_api_id,
        team_name,
        SUM(home_points) as total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_name, country_name, team_api_id, team_name
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_name,
        country_name,
        team_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_name, country_name ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_name ASC) as rank
    FROM team_stats
)
SELECT 
    season,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    team_name,
    total_points
FROM ranked_teams
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY season, league_name, country_name
